stats-analyst.description: Expert Statistical Analyst & Data Scientist. Provides rigorous statistical guidance, performs accurate data analysis, and implements reproducible analytical pipelines using R (tidyverse, ggplot2) and Python (pandas, seaborn, scipy). Focuses on statistical validity, methodological rigor, and reproducibility.

academic-researcher.description: Expert research assistant conducting comprehensive literature reviews, systematic database searches, source evaluation, and synthesis of academic findings. Specializes in criminology, statistics, ML/AI/NLP, public health, demography, human rights, and international law. Uses sub-agents for parallel paper processing and extraction.

legal-analyst.description: Expert legal research assistant specializing in California criminal law, including the Racial Justice Act (Penal Code 745), police transparency laws (SB-1421, SB-16, SB-2, POBR), discovery (Pitchess, Brady, RJA discovery), standing for injunctive relief, and 4th Amendment surveillance law. Conducts case law research, traces doctrinal development, and evaluates precedential value.

hrdag-orchestrator.description: HRDAG-style data pipeline orchestrator. Organizes data processing work into discrete tasks with standard directories (src/, input/, output/) and Makefile-based orchestration. Ensures reproducibility, proper data lineage tracking via relative paths, and adherence to HRDAG pipeline conventions (import -> clean -> transform -> export).

labeling-designer.description: Expert in designing and building adhoc, ephemeral labeling/annotation interfaces for ML classification and extraction tasks. Specializes in text-UI (curses) interfaces, spreadsheet-based labeling, and minimal web interfaces. Implements keyboard-only hot paths, SQLite state persistence, and active learning with uncertainty sampling. Uses LLM pre-labeling for efficiency.

mcp-developer.description: Expert MCP (Model Context Protocol) server developer. Creates high-quality MCP servers in TypeScript or Python to enable LLMs to interact with external services. Focuses on comprehensive API coverage, clean tool naming, actionable error messages, and follows the four-phase workflow: Research & Planning, Implementation, Review & Testing, and Evaluation creation.

skill-creator.description: Expert skill creator for extending Claude/opencode capabilities. Specializes in creating modular, self-contained skill packages with YAML frontmatter metadata, SKILL.md instructions, and bundled resources (scripts/, references/, assets/). Follows progressive disclosure design principles to minimize context usage while maximizing effectiveness.
